welcome.label: Welcome · the rematch

parts.label: 🔎 The case question
parts.title: Does start height matter?
parts.body: How can Sam prove it to Coach Dee?

welcome.script:
(Hold up your phone like you just got a text, and gasp.) Uh oh. Sam just got a text from Coach Dee.

[ON SCREEN: Coach Dee’s texts]
She ran ONE test, and she says start height doesn’t matter. Read her texts. Do you trust her test?

[ON SCREEN: The case question]
Today we find out, the scientist way. Press Listen on Sam’s walkie-talkie, right below me.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · the stopwatch race (Clue 1)
warmup.script:
(Hold up a stopwatch or a phone timer.) I’m going to time something three times. Watch my numbers.

[ON SCREEN: Try it with me]
Were my three times exactly the same? Almost never!

[ON SCREEN: The derby car]
Now it’s your turn. Time the derby car three times and compare. Press Listen.

part1.label: Part 1 · lock it down (Clue 2)

parts.label: 🔒 Lock it down
parts.title: Change only ONE thing
rows: Start: the one thing we test

part1.script:
(Hold up two different shoes.) If I race in two different shoes on two different days, which one made me faster? I can’t tell!

[ON SCREEN: Lock it down]
Coach Dee changed lots of things at once. Lock every row except the start height, then run the fair test. Press Listen.

part2.label: Part 2 · dot plot drop (Clue 3)

parts.label: 📊 Dot plot drop
parts.title: Watch the dots pile up
parts.body: Run at least 5 trials. Then drag the gold marker to the middle of the pile.

part2.script:
[ON SCREEN: Dot plot drop]
One dot can fool you. Five dots make a pile. Run your trials, then find the middle of the pile. Press Listen.

explore.label: Part 4 · data detective (Clue 4)

parts.label: 🧦 Keep it, toss it, or check it?
parts.title: What would a scientist do?
parts.body: Thumbs up: keep it. Thumbs down: throw it out. Magnifying glass: check and redo.

explore.script:
(Squint at a piece of paper like a detective.) Hmm. Something here doesn’t look right.

[ON SCREEN: Data detective]
Coach Dee ran nine trials. One number is way off. Can you find it?

[ON SCREEN: Keep it, toss it, or check it?]
Show me what you’d do with your hand. Then find out what really happened. Press Listen.

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: How can Sam prove it?
parts.body: Pick the answer that fits all four clues.

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
You have four clues. Crack the case at the top of this tab, and a bonus game opens!

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Then write your case report: two short answers, your nine-trial table and your CER. Press Listen.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The claim
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “I rolled a marble down a ramp once and the block moved 8 inches. That’s my whole investigation.”

parts.label: 🧩 The planner
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Tap I agree or I disagree.

evidence.script:
[ON SCREEN: The claim]
One roll, one number, done? Hmm. Think about your stopwatch times. Think about the sock.

There’s no wrong side, as long as you prove it.

[ON SCREEN: The planner]
Tap your side and two facts, then explain how they prove your claim. Try starting with “This shows that…” Press Listen.

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: 🧦 Your specimen
parts.title: The fluke sock
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: 🎯 Bullseye Derby
parts.title: Can you get 9 stars?
parts.body: Roll your car onto the bullseye in 3 levels.

closing.script:
Case closed! A fair test with lots of trials beat one lucky try.

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Finish your checklist, and Coach Dee’s fluke sock goes into your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Confetti]

[ON SCREEN: Bullseye Derby]
Then try Bullseye Derby. Tell me how many stars you got!

[ON SCREEN: Next week]
Next week, we follow the energy. Press Listen for Sam’s last word.

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.
